channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Juno Beach faces fence dispute at JB-7 beach access that could cost thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court brief Thursday challenging an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row. S.D. Spady Elementary School made a dramatic leap from a C rating last year to an A this year.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4 percent this year, with ground beef and strawberries hit hardest
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities in the nation to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem denies coverage for reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage for reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. Her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, said the surgical mesh called GalaFlex is still considered investigational.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to march at National Independence Day Parade in Washington
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march a full mile along the National Mall on July 4 at 10:30 a.m., representing the entire state of Florida.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in house fire days before her birthday
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiance in a deadly home fire earlier this week. Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for renovations projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. When finished, the project will nearly double the dock's capacity, expanding from 18 to 44 slips.

item.title: Port St. Lucie works to expand Midway Road and add Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Last month, the Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: Palm Beach County to consider elevated self-driving transit from West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based autonomous transit company is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles that would connect downtown West Palm Beach to the airport now known as President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: West Palm Beach considers elevated autonomous transit connecting airport to downtown
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied insurance coverage hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma three months ago. Less than 24 hours before her reconstruction surgery, her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for the procedure.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams deploy two boats with medics for Fourth of July boating weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is placing two boats with medics on standby in north and south Martin County as hundreds of boaters hit the waterways for the holiday weekend.

item.description: The downtown Stuart public dock will close July 6 for a year-long renovation that will nearly double capacity from 18 to 44 slips for motorized and non-motorized vessels.

item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a fire at the couple's Hobe Sound home. Friends launched a fundraiser to help her fiancé Mark rebuild after flames destroyed their belongings.

item.description: Stephen McCoy hired Seabreeze Roofing and Sheet Metal in Boynton Beach to replace his roof but said the company left two holes unfinished and stopped responding to his calls.

item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting season programs through September
item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during sea turtle nesting season through September. Available programs include guided Turtle Walks, the Hatchling Discovery Program, Hatchling Releases, Tidal Tots and Plastic Free July Community Action Day.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.description: Mayor Ken Welch selected The Burg Bid proposal to transform 58 acres of stadium parking and public land into a mixed-use district centered on a 13-acre civic park and permanent home for The Woodson African American Museum of Florida.
